subject: SOC 2 Type II & Evidence: MFA rotation, access reviews, and sample logs
messages:
From: Jessica Wong <jessica.wong@curahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@curahealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II request + specific control evidence

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — CuraHealth's security team has one follow-up before we can clear Redwood for our pilot. We have the SOC 2 Type II report request as a baseline, but they also want a few control-level artifacts to validate operational controls:

- MFA token rotation logs (sample) for admin accounts covering a 90-day period
- Evidence of quarterly privileged access reviews (PDF or summary of findings)
- A sanitized sample of authentication/logging events showing admin session creation and revocation

Can you confirm whether you can provide these as an SOP/evidence bundle or whether the bridge letter will need to spell out any gaps? We prefer redacted samples rather than live access.

Timeline: procurement is hoping to close the security review by 2026-09-10 — is that possible?

Appreciate it,
Jessica Wong
Security Engineering Manager, CuraHealth

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Wong <jessica.wong@curahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + specific control evidence

Jessica — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a SOC 2 Type II report plus a bridging letter for any audit period gaps. For the extra control evidence you listed:

- MFA token rotation: we can provide a redacted CSV sample (admin scope) showing rotation timestamps and token IDs for a 90-day window.
- Privileged access reviews: we will attach the latest quarterly review PDF and a one-paragraph executive summary of corrective actions.
- Auth/log samples: we can deliver a small, redacted event sample (session create/revoke) and a short explanation of our logging retention/segregation.

Two quick clarifying questions so we scope correctly:
1) Do you need evidence keyed to specific user IDs or is role-based redaction acceptable?
2) For token rotation, do you need the raw key IDs or just rotation events (timestamp + actor + action)?

We’ll work with Security to assemble the bundle and aim to have it to you by 2026-09-07. If procurement needs faster turnaround we can prioritize the rotation sample first.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II request + specific control evidence

Laura/Dylan — forwarding a request from CuraHealth for control-level artifacts (details below). Can Security prepare:

- Redacted MFA rotation sample (CSV) covering a 90-day window for admin/privileged tokens
- Latest privileged access review PDF + one-paragraph exec summary
- A sanitized auth/log event sample showing session creation/revocation for admin roles

Questions: role-based redaction is fine unless they ask for user-level IDs. If they want key IDs we need to confirm with Security Ops about export format. Timeline: they hope to close by 2026-09-10; I told them we can deliver by 09-07.

Notes to include with artifacts: audit period for SOC 2 Type II is 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31; we will provide a bridge letter that covers controls from 2026-01-01 to present where appropriate.

Thanks — Marcus

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II request + specific control evidence

Marcus — security has pulled the requested artifacts. Summary of what we can deliver by 2026-09-07: 

1) MFA rotation sample (attached as CSV): contains timestamp, role, rotation_event_type (rotate/expire), and a hashed token_id column (hashed for redaction). No PII, no raw key material.

2) Privileged access review: attached PDF (admin_access_review_2025Q4.pdf) and a one-paragraph executive summary we will include as a separate cover page in the bundle.

3) Auth/log sample: we will include a 200-line sanitized sample of session events and a short note on retention (90 days full-detail, aggregate metrics retained 2 years) and where logs are stored (encrypted S3 with KMS).

We will also include our SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2_TypeII_2025_Report.pdf) and a bridge letter that calls out the audit period and any control changes (SOC2_bridge_letter_Q3_2026.pdf).

Attachments in this email: SOC2_TypeII_2025_Report.pdf, SOC2_bridge_letter_Q3_2026.pdf, mfa_token_rotation_sample.csv, admin_access_review_2025Q4.pdf

If CuraHealth needs evidence tied to specific internal user IDs rather than roles, we need a signed data-handling agreement and justification. Otherwise role-based redaction is standard.

Laura Bennett
Director, Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Wong <jessica.wong@curahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, procurement@curahealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request + specific control evidence

Hi Jessica — attaching the bundle from Compliance. Files attached (redacted samples only):

- SOC2_TypeII_2025_Report.pdf (full report)
- SOC2_bridge_letter_Q3_2026.pdf (describes audit period 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 and controls in effect through 2026-09-07)
- mfa_token_rotation_sample.csv (hashed token IDs, rotation timestamps, role, event_type)
- admin_access_review_2025Q4.pdf (quarterly privileged access review, summary + remediation status)

Key notes:
- Role-based redaction was used for tokens and user references. If CuraHealth requires user-identifying data we will need a signed NDA/data handling addendum.
- The bridge letter explains a minor change to our admin onboarding workflow that occurred 2026-02-01; the change is documented and covered by compensating controls (segregation of duties + enhanced monitoring).
- Log retention: full auth logs retained 90 days; aggregated metrics retained 2 years. We can export longer slices under contract if required.

If you'd like, I can set up a short call with Laura to walk through the artifacts on Thursday 2026-09-09. Otherwise let us know if the materials satisfy the review.

Thanks — Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_2025_Report.pdf, SOC2_bridge_letter_Q3_2026.pdf, mfa_token_rotation_sample.csv, admin_access_review_2025Q4.pdf
